lobbyContent.naam_starttijd_plekken_en_i: Name, start time, places and registration status come from the existing tournament. Hidden or completed tournaments are not featured.

lobbyContent.bekijk_de_widget_in_de_kame: View the widget in the room
lobbyContent.de_weekchallenge_en_voortga: The weekly challenge and progress come from the practice area. Each player sees their own doubles hit. Configure the title, explanation and placement here.
lobbyContent.de_inhoud_komt_uit_releaseb: Content comes from Release management. Only additions published to the lobby there appear here. Internal ideas and notes stay in administration. Set the position, width and rooms here.

lobbyContent.de_titel_is_je_vraag_voeg_t: The title is your question. Add two to five different answers.
lobbyContent.iedere_speler_kan_een_stem_: Each player has one vote. Changing the question or answers and republishing starts a new vote.
lobbyContent.geen_selectie_dan_verschijn: No selection? All articles marked visible are shown.
lobbyContent.verborgen_verschijnt_niet_i: · Hidden, does not appear in the lobby

lobbyContent.het_aantal_spelers_en_de_sp: Player count and list always follow the player’s current room. There is no need to configure them for each room.
lobbyContent.de_knop_opent_het_bestaande: The button opens the existing division overview. Manage season assignments under Seasons & divisions.
lobbyContent.laatste_toevoegingen_is_nog: Latest additions has not been configured yet
lobbyContent.gepubliceerde_toevoegingen_: Manage published additions centrally. A deleted widget is not restored automatically.
lobbyContent.een_artikel_te_gebruiken_in: One article, usable in multiple widgets.
lobbyContent.gebruik_een_lege_regel_tuss: Use a blank line between paragraphs.
lobbyContent.een_artikel_verschijnt_via_: An article appears through a news widget. That widget’s room selection determines who sees it. Publish the lobby to make your changes visible.

lobbyContent.sla_op_als_concept_of_publi: Save as a draft or publish directly.
